quest.title: Fungi Are Not Tidalga!
quest.description: After Turenna's departure, the event welcomes another special Melusine player...

talks.objective: Talk to the two people at the stall

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: After a while, you and Paimon arrive at the Lil' Fungi's Fun-Tastic Fiesta booth...

dialogues.speaker: Enghiene
dialogues.text: Mmm! I love these soft, bouncy, smooth, squishy Fungi! Hehe, I want to keep playing!

dialogues.speaker: Enghiene
dialogues.text: I'm Enghiene, and I was Turenna's drillmaster before she entered the Special Patrol!

dialogues.speaker: Enghiene
dialogues.text: I'm nothing like her, you hear? Nothing! I'm not going to grovel before you just because you're Super Zenith Boss-Level Forces!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, so this super arrogant Melusine... used to be Turenna's drillmaster?

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Don't worry, Golden Comet, Silver Companion!

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Ms. Turenna received new orders not long ago, and has returned to the Special Patrol's base.

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Before departing, she asked Ms. Enghiene to watch the event area in her place.

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: She loves Lil' Fungi's Fun-Tastic Fiesta, and we're always playing it.

dialogues.speaker: Enghiene
dialogues.text: That's right! I love both the tabletop game, and those round Fungi in real life!

dialogues.speaker: Enghiene
dialogues.text: They're soft, bouncy, smooth, and squishy... just like Tidalga... Hehehe...

response.speaker: Enghiene
response.text: I won't! I just want to hold them and rub my face against them. Haniyyah didn't mind when I pinched Kindlejoy!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's... That's the most you can do! Only we can hold Bongo-Head!

response.speaker: Enghiene
response.text: You're so stingy! I want them both!

response.speaker: Enghiene
response.text: Haniyyah said you're experts at the game. How about a round against me?

response.speaker: Enghiene
response.text: If I win, I'm going to hold and pinch Bongo-Head!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Grr, she's looking down on us!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Let's do this, {NICKNAME}! As early adopters of the game, we need to show her what we're made of!

choices.text: We're also the first champions of the Nilotpala Cup!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We didn't earn these titles just to be this easily defeated!

choices.text: And the Twin Stars of Brilliant Valor!
You can't eat them! No eating Fungi!
